notes.en: Paper-rendered Figure 4 shows the heavyweight image encoder, prompt encoder, mask decoder and multiple valid masks for ambiguous prompts. It is the clearest compact architecture screenshot for SAM, but the existing original local explainer remains the single selected explanatory image; the HTML rendering states no separate redistribution license.
notes.zh: 论文 HTML 渲染的 Figure 4 展示大型图像编码器、提示编码器、掩码解码器，以及模糊提示下的多个有效掩码，是 SAM 最清晰的紧凑架构截图。页面仍只选用现有本地原创解释图；HTML 渲染未为该图单独声明再分发许可。
